retention.public_artifacts: Retain every published manifest/content bytes and private approval/custody bytes for as long as head,receipt,acceptance or required recovery evidence refers to them. No release-bundle pruning may remove a referenced artifact. First slice has no disposal command for receipts/acceptances/artifacts; later qualified retention/disposal policy remains HOLD. Public artifact reads resolve retained approved bytes only; absent expected bytes503 + operator incident, not404 or substitution.
retention.ceremonies: Expired or consumed v2 ceremony rows eligible after expires_at+24h; indexed bounded cleanup batches <=1000 once/minute, alert on oldest eligible >1h or capacity threshold. No renewal of expiry. Delete only ceremony, never Account/security/key/acceptance/event/permanent legacy fence. Unknown and cleaned attempts remain401; never recreate. Pending Account cleanup is not admitted here; pending admission quotas include retained pending guards and stop new starts before exhaustion.
retention.readiness: Terms artifact/head failure closes terms/enrollment, not otherwise valid established Account reads, refresh, logout or eligible historic login. Shared auth DB outage still fails relevant operations closed.

release_control.owner: Existing deployment/release operator boundary, separate from Company and browser auth
release_control.approval: Operator explicitly authorizes exact TermsPublicationApproval bytes/digest into a deployment custody bundle inaccessible for mutation by app/auth/business roles; approved_by resolves authenticated operator identity in that custody receipt, never a caller claimed role. Publisher is one-shot restricted OS/deployment release command plus dedicated restricted DB publisher role. It resolves only approved digest and verifies all exact bytes and content authority refs before transaction. No public API and no request-time remote lookup.
release_control.no_forgery: A syntactically valid approval, filesystem path or digest alone is insufficient. Unapproved bundle, unresolved operator/content authority, mismatch, or missing bytes rejects publication. Test bundles distinctly TEST_ONLY; production authority remains separately required, never supplied by this design.
release_control.database: Runtime and business roles cannot write head/receipts/approval bytes or invoke publisher mutation. Non-login migration owner, fixed search_path qualified helper, PUBLIC revoked; publisher has head/receipt-only owner helper, no Account locks or Company grants.
